WHAT: The pixel-office-user-prompt.sh hook was added to UserPromptSubmit in settings.json, then explicitly removed per user request to stop token waste.

WHERE:
- Hook script: ~/.claude/hooks/pixel-office-user-prompt.sh (still exists, has PIXEL_OFFICE_HAIKU=1 guard)
- Settings: ~/.claude/settings.json — UserPromptSubmit section no longer references pixel-office-user-prompt.sh
- Route: src/app/api/hooks/user-prompt/route.ts — still exists with pure heuristic extractFocus()

IMPACT: currentFocus field on sessions never updates from user prompts. Workers always show stale task title as their 'focus'.

TO RE-ENABLE: Add back to settings.json UserPromptSubmit matchers:
```json
{
  "matcher": "",
  "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "~/.claude/hooks/pixel-office-user-prompt.sh" }]
}
```

GOTCHA: The hook fires for ALL claude sessions (hooks are global). The script must hit localhost:3000. If server isn't running, it fails silently (curl --silent --max-time 2).
